extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Android build/sign/verify/install/release MCP server with measured certification gates. Slipway ships the Owner's own Android apps and nothing else: signing is consequential-class under a signed-authority chain, every action appends to the slipway.receipt log, and store submission stays a human act. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Slipway does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Slipway

skills.description: Server status, the Android toolchain census, and app inspection before any build is authorized (slipway_status, slipway_toolchain, slipway_inspect).
skills.name: Toolchain and inspection

skills.description: Build, sign, and verify Android artifacts behind measured certification gates (slipway_build, slipway_sign, slipway_verify, slipway_bundle_check).
skills.name: Build, sign, verify

skills.description: Run slipway's measured certification gates over a built artifact and record the verdict in the receipt log (slipway_certify).
skills.name: Certification

skills.description: Open a device session, verify on device, drive the app, install, and close — the on-device half of the release evidence (slipway_device_open, slipway_device_verify, slipway_drive_app, slipway_install, slipway_device_close).
skills.name: Device rung and install

skills.description: Prepare the release bundle and check it; the bundle is the deliverable and store submission stays a human act (slipway_release, slipway_release_check).
skills.name: Release preparation
